faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about Pomocore
faq.description: We've compiled common questions about Pomocore. Check detailed answers about security, usage, troubleshooting, and more.

security.question: What data is tracked when the app runs activity recording?
security.answer: Pomocore collects app information, app titles, and in the case of browsers, URLs as well. The collected data is used only for category classification and data visualization purposes, not for any other purposes.

security.question: How does Pomocore protect data?
security.answer: Pomocore uses AES-256 encryption to protect all activity logs. This is one of the strongest encryption standards currently available. Data is stored on servers but is used solely for providing services to users and is never used for any other purposes.

security.question: Is there any possibility of my personal information being leaked externally?
security.answer: Absolutely not. Pomocore uses user data solely for service provision purposes and never for any other purposes. We do not provide or sell data to third parties, nor is it used in any way without user consent.

features.question: Which applications can be tracked?
features.answer: All applications running on macOS can be tracked. This includes development tools frequently used by developers such as VS Code, Xcode, Chrome, Safari, Figma, Sketch, and AI automatically categorizes them.

features.question: How does tracking work when multiple tabs are open simultaneously?
features.answer: Time recording is based on the tab that the user most recently activated.

features.question: How does the leaderboard work?
features.answer: The leaderboard is a feature that allows comparison of development time within the same team or group. You can check rankings on Daily, Weekly, and Monthly basis, and category-specific expertise can also be compared. The leaderboard reflects the latest data within 20-30 seconds, allowing real-time rank changes to be viewed. All data is processed anonymously.

features.question: Is tracking active even when I'm not doing anything?
features.answer: No. Pomocore detects AFK (Away From Keyboard) status based on 15 minutes. If there's no activity for 15 minutes, it determines the user has stepped away and stops log tracking. Tracking automatically resumes when activity starts again.

installation.question: Which macOS versions are supported?
installation.answer: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) and above are supported. It's optimized for the latest macOS Sequoia and Sonoma, and works smoothly on both Intel Mac and Apple Silicon Mac.
